author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm) — multi-τ pooling {0.125,0.25,0.5} — BiGRU=160, k=7 — seed=42
abstract: Adds a parsimonious multi-τ pooling mix (mean + LSE at τ∈{0.125,0.25,0.5}) to the Conv+Pooling expert with scalar-gated fusion and post-fusion LayerNorm. Hypothesis: variable sharpness captures motif-scale diversity, improving PRS/CRISPR without harming Modif/ncRNA.
